- Episodic pallor and cyanosis are hallmark clinical signs of acute right-to-left shunting during hypercyanotic spells in TOF.  
- No documented dyspnea, feeding difficulties, or failure to thrive — compatible with moderate (non-critical) pulmonary stenosis in TOF, allowing for compensated circulation into early toddlerhood.

Tetralogy of Fallot
